title: Magic Frames
description: Magic Frames are Item Frames that turn invisible when there is an item in them.
body:
# Magic Frames

> Inspired by [this Reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/minecraftsuggestions/comments/1uavxjr/invisible_item_frames_crafted_from_phantom/).

Have you ever wanted to use invisible Item Frames in survival Minecraft? Now you can! They are called **Magic Frames** and can be crafted in a crafting table.


## 🌟 Features
- Crafted with a **Phantom Membrane** and 8 **Glass Panes**
- **Enchanted icon** to distinguish from regular Item Frames
- Invisible **when there is an item inside**


## 📃 Usage

![Crafting recipe with a Phantom Membrane surrounded by 8 Glass Panes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ace191ef283b162dc95676f9b6bc4c68bf848cde.png)

1. Craft a **Magic Frame** like this
2. Place it on the ground (it will be **visible**)
3. **Put an item inside** to make it invisible
